article_title: Six Flags shuts down X2 rollercoaster after hundreds allege brain injuries

tasks.prompt: What is the main development reported in the article?
options: Six Flags will permanently retire the X2 rollercoaster after lawsuits and hundreds of alleged brain injuries.
Six Flags will build a second X2 ride in another state.
The X2 reopened after a short weather closure.
California banned every rollercoaster in the state.
tasks.correct_answer: Six Flags will permanently retire the X2 rollercoaster after lawsuits and hundreds of alleged brain injuries.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האירוע המרכזי הוא החלטת Six Flags לסגור לצמיתות את X2 על רקע תביעות וטענות של מאות נוסעים לפגיעות מוחיות.

tasks.prompt: Why did the park say it was retiring X2 even though the ride had passed safety tests?
options: The park had run out of electricity.
Guest confidence had been affected, and the park said closure was the right thing to do.
The ride was moved to Europe.
The manufacturer requested a temporary repaint.
tasks.correct_answer: Guest confidence had been affected, and the park said closure was the right thing to do.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הנהלת הפארק אמרה שהמתקן עבר בדיקות, אך אמון המבקרים נפגע ולכן החליטה שהסגירה היא הצעד הנכון.

tasks.prompt: What does “cornerstone” mean in the statement that ride safety is a cornerstone of the business?
options: A decorative part of the ride
A legal payment to plaintiffs
A basic and essential principle
A temporary repair
tasks.explanation_hebrew: cornerstone פירושה אבן יסוד—עיקרון בסיסי וחיוני. החברה מציגה את בטיחות המתקנים כערך מרכזי בעסק.

tasks.prompt: Which statement correctly describes the history of the ride?
options: It first opened in 2022 and never changed.
It has always been called X2 and used the same trains.
It operated only for one summer.
It opened as X in 2002, later received lighter trains, and reopened as X2 in 2008.
tasks.correct_answer: It opened as X in 2002, later received lighter trains, and reopened as X2 in 2008.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המתקן נפתח בשם X בשנת 2002, נסגר לתיקונים ולהחלפת הרכבות, ונפתח מחדש בשם X2 בשנת 2008.

tasks.prompt: What does “plaintiffs” mean in the article?
options: Engineers who inspect rides
People who bring a civil case to court
Visitors who buy annual passes
Employees who operate rollercoasters
tasks.correct_answer: People who bring a civil case to court
tasks.explanation_hebrew: plaintiffs הם תובעים—אנשים שמגישים תביעה אזרחית לבית המשפט נגד צד אחר.

tasks.prompt: Why do lawyers for injured riders say the permanent closure is not enough?
options: They want the ride to become faster.
They believe safety tests should be cancelled.
The closure may protect future visitors but cannot undo injuries, surgery or a death already alleged.
They want Six Flags to shorten waiting times.
tasks.correct_answer: The closure may protect future visitors but cannot undo injuries, surgery or a death already alleged.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עורכי הדין מברכים על הגנה עתידית, אך מדגישים שהסגירה אינה מתקנת את הפגיעות החמורות ואת האובדן שכבר התרחשו לפי הטענות.

tasks.prompt: Give three details that show the seriousness of the allegations against X2.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה פרטים קונקרטיים מן הכתבה שממחישים את חומרת הטענות.
expected_points: Hundreds of people contacted a law firm alleging injuries linked to the ride.
Some riders allegedly suffered catastrophic or traumatic brain injuries.
Some people reportedly needed emergency brain surgery.
A wrongful-death lawsuit concerned a 22-year-old who died after riding X2 in 2022.
Multiple civil lawsuits were filed against the park.

tasks.prompt: Why can a ride passing safety tests still fail to maintain public confidence?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הפער בין עמידה בבדיקות פורמליות לבין ניסיון המבקרים, טענות חוזרות, תביעות ואמון הציבור.
expected_points: Formal tests may not detect every design flaw or real-world risk.
Repeated injury allegations can make visitors question whether tests are sufficient.
Severe outcomes have a stronger effect on trust than a general safety statement.
Delayed action can make the company appear reactive rather than proactive.

tasks.prompt: Summarise X2's history, the injury allegations and Six Flags' decision.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את התפתחות המתקן, היקף השימוש, הטענות לפגיעות, התביעות והסיבה שנמסרה לסגירה.
expected_points: The ride opened as X in 2002 and reopened as X2 with lighter trains in 2008.
Its seats spin 360 degrees, and the park says more than 16 million people rode it.
Hundreds alleged injuries, and several civil lawsuits described severe brain damage.
A previous wrongful-death case was settled.
Six Flags permanently retired X2, citing safety and lost guest confidence despite passed tests.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, assess whether amusement-ride safety should rely mainly on company testing or stronger outside oversight.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג עמדה מנומקת, להשתמש בלפחות שלוש ראיות מן הכתבה ולהתייחס גם לבדיקות החברה וגם לפיקוח חיצוני.
expected_points: Company testing can provide regular technical checks and operational data.
X2 reportedly passed many tests despite later serious allegations.
Design problems, lawsuits and severe outcomes suggest internal testing may be insufficient alone.
Independent regulators can investigate patterns across riders and require transparent reporting.
A proactive system should act on early warning signs before public confidence collapses.
A balanced answer may support both company responsibility and independent oversight.
